prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: revised stylized 3D vehicle concept sheet for an arcade idle RPG.
Inputs: image 1 is the edit target and vehicle identity reference; image 2 is the friendly Quasimodo character identity reference.
Primary request: revise the vehicle layout to match these exact corrections. Keep the dark graphite classic Mustang front, twin ivory racing stripes, four round headlights, central silver hood intake, chunky wheels, weathered casual 3D materials and the small single-barrel hood prop's present size.

CHANGE 1 — RIGHT SIDE SWIVEL: move the compact single-barrel gun to the VEHICLE'S RIGHT side of the hood, to the right of the center intake in driving direction. In the top view with front of car at the TOP of the page, the gun MUST be on the PAGE RIGHT. Mount it on a visibly separate LOW circular swivel base, with a simple small cradle, so it clearly rotates sideways. In the main view aim its barrel slightly outward to the vehicle's right to show this motion. Preserve the small size; no tall tower or large dome. Show only a simple fictional game-prop exterior.

CHANGE 2 — MUSTANG PICKUP REAR: convert the rear body to a believable coupe-utility / small pickup version of this same Mustang. The short enclosed cabin and its roof END immediately behind the two seats. Behind the cab is an OPEN-TOP recessed cargo bed with visible interior floor, two low side walls and a rear tailgate. Remove the fastback roof and trunk deck from this rear area. It must still look like a low Mustang-based ute, not a tall truck.

CHANGE 3 — MOUNTED HARPOON TURRET WITH OPERATOR: place friendly Quasimodo STANDING INSIDE this bed, feet on its recessed floor and his lower legs partly enclosed by the bed walls. He wears the brown cap, yellow goggles, mustard jacket, brown trousers and warm friendly face from image 2. In front of him is a compact stylized harpoon TURRET, fixed to the bed floor on its own circular rotating pedestal, with a simple supported launcher, one visible harpoon tip and a small cable reel. He stands BEHIND the turret and operates its rear handles with both hands. The pedestal and launcher support must be visible and distinct from his arms. The harpoon points forward, just clearing the low cab. Keep this as a playful fictional vehicle attachment, with simplified external forms. No handheld harpoon and no character standing on the roof.

Composition: one landscape concept sheet with THREE consistent views of the exact same revised vehicle. Large FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view on the left, car nose directed toward lower-right so the vehicle's right hood gun is foreground-visible. Upper right: REAR-RIGHT three-quarter elevated view with the OPEN cargo bed, character's feet, tailgate and harpoon turret base clearly visible. Lower right: clean TOP view, front at PAGE TOP, hood gun on PAGE RIGHT. All views must match the same right-side gun position and pickup conversion. Remove old number 05, old inset and old layout. No labels or text.
Scene: neutral warm sand studio backdrop with soft contact shadows, no action scene. Polished casual stylized 3D game concept art, readable rounded shapes, soft light.
Constraints: exactly one small hood gun and one bed-mounted harpoon turret per vehicle. No additional weapons, no firing, no ammunition details, no cutaways or technical assembly diagrams. The open rear bed and the visibly pivoting right-side hood gun are the main corrections.

prompts.stage: correct right-side placement in perspective views
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing three-view stylized vehicle concept sheet. Preserve the whole image, car, pickup bed, friendly operator, mounted harpoon turret, backgrounds, cameras, scale and materials. Make ONLY one correction: the hood gun must be on the SAME physical VEHICLE RIGHT SIDE in all three views. The lower-right TOP-DOWN view is ALREADY CORRECT: front is up, gun is on page right. Keep that top-down view unchanged.

The LARGE LEFT FRONT THREE-QUARTER view is currently wrong: the gun is on the far side of the hood. MOVE that same small hood gun with its low circular rotating base to the NEAR/VISIBLE side of the hood. In this large panel that means place it to the IMAGE LEFT and slightly BELOW the central silver intake, over the ivory stripe nearer the large foreground front wheel. Center the base approximately at x=440, y=595 in the full 1536x1024 sheet. The exact perspective of the hood determines final placement. Erase the previous gun from its old image-right location and restore the hood and stripe there. Keep one hood gun only. Its barrel can face diagonally forward with a slight sideways swivel, maintaining the identical compact size.

The UPPER-RIGHT REAR THREE-QUARTER view also needs the same correction: move that small hood gun from the distant upper outer edge of the hood to the NEAR SIDE of the hood, the passenger side beside the visible near front wheel and near door. That is IMAGE BELOW the central silver intake in this small panel, closer to the viewer. Match the right-side position shown in the correct top-down view. Erase its old copy. Keep exactly one small hood gun per car.

The right-side placement is vehicle-relative, not page-relative: the perspective panels must not mirror the correct top-down anatomy. All pickup-bed details and the floor-mounted harpoon turret operated from behind are already correct; do not change them. No new text or labels. Keep the same single-barrel fictional game prop on a visible low swivel ring, no extra props.
